tasks.spec: ROLE: fix worker for the Mott goal-loop Bland pathway, round 8. Work entirely inside your current working directory; never modify, create, or delete any file outside CWD. No network, no git, no MCP or Apps, no skills. Do not mint, attach, deploy, or call any API. CONTEXT - all three defects below were measured on the LIVE v103 line during a real patient-side test (conversation transcript and gateway ground truth on record; do not re-derive): DEFECT A, established-date clobber: with offers standing on Tuesday 08/18/2026, the day-less ask 'What's the latest time I can come in?' re-extracted preference_from down to bare 'tuesday' and the gateway resolved the NEAREST Tuesday (08/11) - the established explicit date was lost. Production d7 solved exactly this with searches pinned to the already-offered date. DEFECT B, gate mis-pick on clock-time reply: offers were '05:15 pm or 05:00 pm' (slot_1=05:15); the reply 'Let's do 515' routed to n_gate_2 (second opening, 05:00) instead of n_gate_1 - the gate edge labels ('takes only the first/second opening offered') give the router no clock-time hint. DEFECT C, booked-message lies: n_confirm has NO slot template variables - its LLM prompt freely generated 'booked for 05:15 pm' while n_book_2 actually booked 05:00 pm (gateway appt-list is ground truth). The confirm copy must be template-verbatim per booked branch, the same round-4 convention the offer copy already follows. SOURCE MATERIALS (read-only; copy into CWD before editing): /home/ankit114/repos/ringer/my-manifests/mk2-number-and-comeback/workGLD7/gl-round7-fix/ has the round-7 draft (minted as v103), validator (assertions 1-7), build/derive scripts, fixtures; /home/ankit114/repos/ringer/my-manifests/mk2-number-and-comeback/workGLD4/capture-v96/graph.json is the stored production graph; /home/ankit114/repos/ringer/my-manifests/mk2-number-and-comeback/workEve/pathway-d7-builder/validator_amendments.md documents the proven d7 offered-date search pattern. THE FIX, exactly: (1) ADD two availability webhook nodes, cloned from the existing searches with ONLY these deltas: n_goal_search_offered_latest - body from and to both exactly '{{slot_1_start}}', time_pref 'latest'; n_goal_search_offered_time - body from and to both exactly '{{slot_1_start}}', time_pref 'none' (after stays '{{time_after}}'). Bodies remain inside the ten-field gateway contract (store, from, to, after, before, time_pref, slot_minutes, callID, user_text, user_verbatim). Same url, method, headers, responseData, responsePathways (targets adjusted only as node ids require), retry/skip settings as the cloned source. (2) EDGES from n_goal_response: add to n_goal_search_offered_latest with label 'wants late, latest, last appointment, or end of day on the offered date'; add to n_goal_search_offered_time with label 'gives only a time preference on the already offered date, excluding late, latest, last appointment, or end of day' (both labels are the proven d7 wording). Narrow the existing generic-latest edge label to 'wants late, latest, last appointment, or end of day on a NAMED day different from the offered date' so the two latest routes cannot collide. (3) GATE labels: append ', including by naming that opening's clock time' to the n_gate_1 and n_gate_2 edge labels from n_goal_response (the words 'clock time' must appear). (4) CONFIRMS: replace the single n_confirm with n_confirm_1 and n_confirm_2. Each is a Default node whose patient-facing copy is TEMPLATE-VERBATIM, not LLM-freeform: n_confirm_1 must render '{{slot_1_day_name}} {{slot_1_start}}' and n_confirm_2 '{{slot_2_day_name}} {{slot_2_start}}' as the booked time (keep the rest of the existing confirm wording and the office phone number). Retarget n_book_1's success route (edges and responsePathways) to n_confirm_1 and n_book_2's to n_confirm_2; reconcile nodes keep their existing outcomes; every former n_confirm inbound/outbound edge must be rehomed to the correct branch confirm, and the e_booked outcome must remain reachable from both confirms exactly as it was from n_confirm. (5) All prior conventions hold: no n_goal_update, no silent Default feeding a webhook, ten-field bodies only, no retain, extractors on user-wait feeders byte-equal stored v96 n_ask (plus goal_anchor on n_goal_response only), executable responsePathway conditions, verbatim slot wiring in all patient copy. (6) VALIDATOR: extend check_goalloop_graph.py with ASSERTION 8 keeping 1-7 intact: (a) both offered-date searches exist with from==to=='{{slot_1_start}}' and their exact time_pref values; (b) the n_goal_response edges to them exist with offered-date wording, and gate edges carry the clock-time clause; (c) n_confirm is absent while n_confirm_1/n_confirm_2 exist, each templating its own slot_N_day_name and slot_N_start, and each book node's success path targets its matching confirm. Structured FAIL lines citing 'assertion 8' (or the specific older assertion), no tracebacks; PASS on success. Your validator must PASS your new draft and FAIL the untouched round-7 draft at /home/ankit114/repos/ringer/my-manifests/mk2-number-and-comeback/workGLD7/gl-round7-fix/pathway-goalloop-draft.json with an assertion citation. (7) Update build_goalloop.py so rerunning regenerates the draft and fixtures deterministically; update fixture-conformant.json for all eight assertions. (8) DEBUG.md documents round 8: the three measured defects and the changes (must discuss the confirm split, the gate labels, and the offered-date searches) plus the regeneration command. DELIVERABLES in CWD: build_goalloop.py, derive_goalloop.py if used, check_goalloop_graph.py, pathway-goalloop-draft.json, fixtures, DEBUG.md.
tasks.verified: The round-8 draft passes its eight-assertion validator, the validator rejects the v103 draft, and an independent check proves the offered-date-pinned searches, clock-time gate labels, per-branch template-verbatim confirms wired to their matching book nodes, and every prior-round convention intact.
